title: The Spring Beneath the Sand
intro: In the annals of the Quran, a figure of immense patience faced a trial that would break the stoutest hearts. Everything was stripped away - wealth, family, and health. Yet from the depths of despair, a humble prayer was answered in the most unexpected way. Can you identify this soul whose story of restoration echoes through the ages?
clues: I was tested with a trial so severe that it is remembered throughout the ages.
I lost everything that mattered - my wealth, my children, and my health.
My body was covered with painful sores, and I was shunned by all.
In my desperation, I called to Allah, saying that Satan had touched me with hardship and torment.
Allah answered me and commanded me to strike the earth with my foot.
From that very spot, a cool spring burst forth, and Allah restored my family and doubled them as a mercy.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
